_: Shared editorial for the wedges. Merged UNDER each wedge's own file.
carePara: Grooves full of sand do not spin anything. Brush the face after a round and dry the head before it goes back in the bag — that is the whole maintenance routine.
A head cover is worth it if your clubs rattle around in a cart. Reviewers mention picking up cart rash without one more than they mention anything else.
marquee: Sold direct, never through a middleman
